title: LineagePilot Phase 0: Spikes and customer discovery
description: Ends with Gate G0. See docs/implementation_plan.md Phase 0.
close_reason: Phase 0 complete: S1-S3 done, S4 waived, Gate G0 passed (LP-1ay.5).

title: S1 Packaging spike: universal VSIX with bundled pure-Python libs
description: Done when: a minimal pygls server, launched via an interpreter found with @vscode/python-extension, returns a CodeLens on macOS, Windows and Linux with Python 3.10 and 3.13; every runtime dependency installs with --implementation py. Confirms or overturns D-2.
close_reason: Met 1 Nov 2026. One universal VSIX (1.36 MB, 0 compiled files) starts the bundled pygls server and returns a CodeLens on Windows, macOS and Linux with Python 3.10 and 3.13: GitHub Actions run 41317287230 (commit 04cfa69), 54/54 tests, plus local macOS arm64 and Linux arm64 runs. Interpreter found via setting, @vscode/python-extension and PATH. D-2 confirmed. Report: spikes/s1-packaging/README.md

comments.author: rademola
comments.text: S1 measured 1 Nov 2026 (spikes/s1-packaging/README.md). One universal VSIX (1.36 MB, 0 compiled files) built on macOS passes in VS Code 1.144.0 on macOS arm64 and Linux arm64: 3 interpreter sources x Python 3.10/3.13, 36/36 tests. Bundle passes stdio tests on Linux x86_64 too. Remaining: Windows, via .github/workflows/lineagepilot-s1.yml (needs a push). Findings: --only-binary=:all: required; PyYAML built pure from hashed sdist; pygls 2.1 rejects param-less requests; restricted mode must not run workspace interpreters.

title: S2 Parse and performance spike on real dbt manifests
description: Done when: existing dbt_parser runs without the DB layer; design section 11 budgets are measured on 2,000- and 5,000-model manifests (dbt Core 1.8+ and Fusion); supported manifest versions are pinned.
close_reason: Measured 1 Nov 2026 (spikes/s2-parse-perf/README.md). Parser runs without the DB layer (no httpx/snowflake/sqlalchemy/fastapi/pydantic loaded). Budgets measured on 2k and 5k models, Python 3.10/3.13, dbt Core 1.8-1.12 and Fusion 2.0.9. As-is misses cold index at 5k (6.0 s on 3.13, 16.5 s on 3.10) and RSS (~1 GB); a one-line lineage-loop fix gives 1.95-2.16 s, and indexing in a child process keeps server RSS at ~106 MB. All other budgets met. Pinned manifest schema v12 (gate on dbt_schema_version).

title: S3 Static DAG analysis spike (Cosmos, BashOperator dbt commands)
description: Done when: AST-only scanning (no import/exec) gives correct task-to-model links on 3 public example DAG repositories, with misses listed.
close_reason: Measured 1 Nov 2026 (spikes/s3-static-dag/README.md). AST-only, never imported: 84/84 expected links found on 3 public repos (astronomer-cosmos, cosmos-demo, airflow-dbt-demo); 75/75 resolvable links correct, 9 legitimate unknowns, 0 misses, 0 false positives. In-sample, so an upper bound; held-out 4 repos labelled blind with the scanner frozen: 9 links, 5 correct, 4 legit unknowns, 0 misses. A literals-only scanner (design 6.2 as written) misses 19/84 (22.6%). Selector engine agrees with dbt ls on 42/42 supported expressions. 132 tests, 88% coverage.

title: S4 Customer discovery: interview 10 dbt+Airflow teams with review mock
description: Done when: notes per interview cover the last costly change, how they review impact today, and whether a clickable Change Impact Review mock would change that.
close_reason: Waived by the product owner on 1 November 2026. Outcome taken as given from their experience as data engineer, data engineering lead and data architect. G0 criterion 2 is treated as met by owner judgment; market validation now rests on the Phase 6 beta and Gate G1.

title: Gate G0: go/no-go after spikes and discovery
description: Proceed only if S1 and S2 meet their criteria (confirming D-2) and S3 shows a credible static-analysis path. The market-need criterion is met by product-owner judgment (S4 waived 1 Nov 2026); market validation moves to the Phase 6 beta and Gate G1. If it fails, stop before Phase 1.
close_reason: Gate G0 passed: product owner approved proceeding to Phase 1 on 2 Nov 2026. Evidence in spikes/G0_REPORT.md.

comments.author: rademola
comments.text: S4 waived by the product owner (1 Nov 2026). G0 criterion 2 is met by owner judgment rather than interviews. G0 now turns on S1-S3 evidence; see spikes/G0_REPORT.md once written.

comments.author: rademola
comments.text: G0 decision (2 Nov 2026): PROCEED to Phase 1. Product owner accepted the recommendation in spikes/G0_REPORT.md. title: 2.1 pygls server: workspace discovery, indexing, debounced file watching
description: Watch target/, DAG folders and rule packs; one server per dbt workspace folder; stdio only.

comments.author: rademola
comments.text: S2: run indexing in a child process, not the asyncio loop or a thread. await parse() stalls the loop 1.8-2.2 s at 5k models and to_thread still leaves 100-520 ms GIL stalls. The indexer peaks at 0.66-1.06 GB transiently; the server loading the snapshot stays at ~106 MB. A JSON snapshot loads faster than SQLite (0.17 s at 5k).

description: Exit: full acceptance scenario passes; miss rate on the S3 repositories is measured and reported.

title: 5.1 dag_static.py: AST scanner for Cosmos, dbt commands, SQL operators, task deps
description: Never import or execute DAG files. Grows from spike S3.

comments.author: rademola
comments.text: S3 (1 Nov 2026): literal-only operands miss 22.6% of links. Grow the spike scanner (spikes/s3-static-dag) and include: constants imported from workspace modules (AST only), Path(__file__) arithmetic and env-var defaults (heuristic), one-level inlining of local helpers called with literals, BashOperator cwd, Airflow file discovery (safe-mode heuristic, .airflowignore, skip dbt project folders), and exclude dbt-loom external nodes. Store the Cosmos group-level orchestrates edge as primary evidence and derive task ids from it (mapping in the S3 README), pinned to a Cosmos version range. Pin selector semantics to the manifest's dbt version (1.10 changed wildcards) with a dbt ls conformance test in CI. Report unfollowed calls at the call site. Decide what a 'dbt test' task links to.

title: 5.2 Annotation file support via data_flow_annotations
description: Covers what static analysis cannot see.

comments.author: rademola
comments.text: S3: container/in-image path remapping was the largest single cause of misses (15/84). Support suffix matching for /usr/local/airflow-style paths (heuristic) plus an explicit path map in the annotation file.

title: 5.3 Feed orchestrates edges into CodeLens, Airflow tree and review

comments.author: rademola
comments.text: S3: 71 of 75 correct links were 'heuristic' confidence. The review must show heuristic links by default, labelled, or it hides most real links.

description: No guesses: dynamic constructs surface as unknown.

comments.author: rademola
comments.text: S3: name the unknown categories seen in the wild: remote manifest (s3/gs/abfs), tasks generated from manifest.json at parse time, wrapper class, loop or factory, generated project, unsupported selector, Jinja, DAG that cannot load.

title: 5.5 Held-out DAG corpus: 10+ repos labelled before tuning
description: S3's clean result is in-sample (scanner built while reading the same repos) and its held-out set had only 9 links. Label 10+ unseen dbt+Airflow repos blind, with more BashOperator, KubernetesPodOperator and DockerOperator DAGs, before any Phase 5 tuning: this task deliberately depends only on G0 so it can run early, in parallel with Phases 1-4. At the Phase 5 exit, freeze the scanner (record its hash) and measure the miss rate on this corpus, not the S3 one.

comments.author: rademola

title: HTML and CSV reports: stored HTML injection and formula injection
description: api/routers/reports.py builds HTML with f-strings and no escaping (381-384, 405-408, 428-435, 550-554): column/capsule names, pii_type, layer, data_type, rule_name, subject_name, message. Served as attachment, so payload runs when the saved .html is opened (file://, no CSP) and can exfiltrate the PII inventory. CSV output (98-115, 199-214, 294-312) quotes correctly but does not neutralise cells starting with = + - @ TAB CR. Fix: html.escape every value or Jinja2 autoescape=True, add restrictive meta CSP; prefix apostrophe on formula-leading CSV cells.

comments.author: rademola

title: Cypher export injection: unescaped URNs in relationship MATCH statements
description: services/graph_export.py:729-733 interpolates edge.source_urn/target_urn into double-quoted Cypher strings. URNs embed attacker-controlled dbt model names and domain/tag/product names. A model named x"}) RETURN 1; MATCH (n) DETACH DELETE n; MATCH (a {urn: "y produces a statement that wipes the target Neo4j DB when the exported script is run (cypher-shell -f / Browser). Same path via CLI (cli/main.py:1193). Fix: json.dumps the URNs as node properties already do, or emit parameterised UNWIND $rows; whitelist labels and rel types.

title: Graph export encoding: GraphML/DOT/Mermaid injection and Content-Disposition filename
description: graph_export.py: GraphML writes node.layer/domain unescaped (611-612; element injection, ill-formed XML); DOT puts layer raw in subgraph name and label and leaves IDs unquoted (665-691); Mermaid uses raw layer and URN IDs and does not strip newlines (752-773). graph.py:189-201 builds Content-Disposition filename from the URN tail (parameter injection; non-Latin-1 names cause a 500 and break the lineage view). Fix: escape all interpolated values per format, use generated node IDs (n0, n1...), restrict filename to [A-Za-z0-9_-] and add RFC 5987 filename*.
